questionText: The dietary approach recommended in clinical nutrition for managing hypertension (DASH diet) emphasizes:

options.text: High saturated animal fats and refined table sugar with zero dietary fiber
High sodium chloride intake with complete restriction of green vegetables
Exclusive consumption of red processed meats without water
High potassium, calcium, magnesium, and dietary fiber with restricted sodium intake

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:

The DASH (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension) diet emphasizes fruits, vegetables, whole grains, poultry, fish, and nuts, reducing sodium, red meats, sweets, and saturated fats to lower blood pressure.

Hence, Option (D) is the correct answer.

questionText: In pediatric clinical assessment, Kwashiorkor is clinically distinguished from Marasmus by the prominent presence of:

options.text: Severe muscle wasting and subcutaneous fat depletion without oedema (skin and bone appearance)
Vitamin C scurvy bleeding gums exclusively
Oedema (fluid accumulation in legs and face) and enlarged fatty liver with adequate calorie intake but acute protein deficiency
Excessive subcutaneous adipose tissue and childhood obesity

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Public Nutrition and Health - Nutritional Deficiency: Kwashiorkor vs Marasmus):
Kwashiorkor is caused by acute protein deficiency despite sufficient caloric intake, leading to generalized oedema, enlarged fatty liver, lethargy, and a 'moon face'. Marasmus is total protein-energy malnutrition characterized by severe wasting without oedema.

Hence, Option (C) is the correct answer.

questionText: In industrial dairy technology, High-Temperature Short-Time (HTST) pasteurization of milk involves heating milk to:

options.text: 100°C for two hours under boiling pressure

63°C for fifteen seconds followed by storage at room temperature
140°C for twenty minutes continuously

detailedSolution:

questionText: When removing protein-based stains (such as blood or egg) from fabrics, one should strictly avoid using hot water because:

options.text: Hot water coagulates the protein, setting the stain permanently into the fabric fibers
Hot water bleaches synthetic dyes instantly
Protein stains dissolve only in boiling concentrated sulphuric acid
Hot water transforms the protein into insoluble cellulose wax

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Home_Science (Care and Maintenance of Fabrics in Institutions - Stain Removal: Protein Stains):
Protein coagulates when heated. Washing blood or egg stains with hot water 'cooks' the protein into the yarns, fixing it permanently. Protein stains must always be treated first with cold or lukewarm water and mild enzymatic detergent.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

questionText: In apparel design, using prominent vertical lines in a garment visually creates the optical impression of:

questionText:
Read the following consumer protection and regulatory enforcement case study and answer the questions that follow:

A commercial health supplement brand, 'MaxiHeight Pro', launches an aggressive multi-media advertising campaign on national television and social media. The advertisements feature a celebrity sports star claiming that consuming their powder guarantees a height increase of 6 inches in adults aged 20 to 35 within 90 days. A coalition of consumer activists and pediatrician associations lodges a formal complaint before the Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA). The CCPA's Investigation Wing, headed by a Director-General, conducts an inquiry and establishes that the claim is biologically impossible, scientifically bogus, and constitutes a 'Misleading Advertisement' under Section 2(28) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The CCPA exercises its statutory powers: ordering immediate discontinuation of the advertisements, imposing a financial penalty of Rs. 10 lakhs on the manufacturer, directing full refund to all purchasers, and prohibiting the celebrity endorser from endorsing any product for a period of one year.

Question: Why was the celebrity sports star penalized under CPA 2019 for endorsing 'MaxiHeight Pro'?

options.text: Under CPA 2019, celebrity endorsers face strict liability and are automatically penalized regardless of any prior due diligence conducted.
Under CPA 2019, celebrity endorsers are held accountable for misleading claims unless they can prove due diligence was conducted to verify efficacy.
Under CPA 2019, celebrity endorsers are prohibited from promoting any commercial health or dietary supplements to the public.
Under CPA 2019, celebrity endorsers are required to obtain written approval from the Central Consumer Protection Authority prior to broadcast.

detailedSolution:

Under CPA 2019, celebrity endorsers are held accountable for misleading claims unless they can prove due diligence was conducted to verify efficacy.

Option A accurately reflects Section 21 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, which holds endorsers liable for misleading advertisements unless they exercised due diligence to satisfy themselves about the veracity of the claims. The distractors (B, C, D) are plausible, structurally balanced legal options, but factually incorrect under the CPA 2019 framework.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.
